AGIO

A white box. Precision in black lines.

VISUAL IDEA

Design,
assembled in volume.

A minimal palette gives room to a detailed drawing of the wall light. Linework reveals form and texture while keeping the composition light.

Logo, name and technical information are separated by scale. The illustration continues onto the adjacent face, making the package read as a three-dimensional object.
